text: For a substantial minority, existing systems fail Form PF for a specific reason: 34.78 percent of respondents said their internal reporting systems were insufficient because the required answers demand further analysis and calculation beyond what the systems already produce.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Fund Disclosures Under the Dodd-Frank Act (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2447306

isBasedOn.name: Private Fund Disclosures Under the Dodd-Frank Act

abstract: Several respondents (34.78%) opined that their existing internal reporting systems were insufficient to respond to questions on Form PF because they require further analysis and calculations.
